puzzle.hint: A powerful command of tawakkul (reliance on Allah) — reminding believers that placing trust in Allah alone is enough, for He suffices as the ultimate Protector and Disposer of all affairs.
puzzle.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا
puzzle.verseEn: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
